title: What is topological data analysis? A comprehensive introduction
subtitle: From the shape of a point cloud to persistent homology, persistence diagrams, and the images we can use in machine learning.
summary: How do we make a computer see the shape of data? An introduction through handwritten digits, holes, and persistence images.

title: When football results refuse to add up
subtitle: Six matches, five teams, and a question: what can one number per team really explain? A journey from goal margins to Hodge theory.
summary: A three-goal win, a two-goal win, and a prediction that does not add up. Follow six football matches from the search for a ranking to the holes in the fixture list.
